race.comment: Wide open with plenty of win chances but looking at a couple of improvers down in grade. SPANGLED SIPPER (2) has raced in richer company the last two, the latest eighth in town over a bit further. Freshened for this and will be charging home strongly. Same goes for SHE'S TERNACIOUS (1). Winner two back at Murray Bridge then began awkwardly and was back throughout from a wide draw, turning back and deep and making ground late without threatening. That has proven a hot form race and draws much better this time. Worth forgiving. AFFAIRE VUE (3) returned from a break at Bordertown and wound up strong to score. Fitter again and can go back-to-back. MAGIC ISLAND (7) is better than recent form looks. Will be prominent throughout. LIMBERING (6) is a veteran mare but racing well and can give a sight again.
